note: Shared producer/consumer REPLY vectors for the ADR-0033 local interface. Schema: policy_local_replies.schema.json. `request` is the exact request frame the reply answers. layer=schema negatives must fail the JSON Schema; layer=semantic negatives pass the schema but violate a cross-field rule (docs 'Semantic reply checks'). Raw vectors are reply lines exercising frame-level rules. Replies over 65536 bytes are generated, not stored.
